services.title: What I bring to your organization
services.intro: Services tailored to nonprofits and SMBs: pragmatic, documented, jargon-free. You don't need a full-time IT director — you need a trusted technical partner.
services.pricingNote: These are quoted after a first conversation about your setup: the price depends on your estate, not on a catalogue. Free quote, no commitment — and if you need the website and the security work together, the <packs>packages</packs> cover the most common cases.

items.title: Security check-up
items.description: Review of your setup: weak points, misconfigurations and improvement areas. Clear report with prioritized recommendations.

items.title: Systems administration
items.description: Management of your Linux/Windows servers, routers and firewalls. Monitoring with Zabbix, updates and rapid response.

items.title: Infrastructure hardening
items.description: System hardening, network segmentation, access and password management. Solid foundations to reduce your exposure.

items.title: Virtualization
items.description: Deployment and administration of your on-premise virtualized environments (Proxmox, VMware). Containerization with Docker.

items.title: Business continuity
items.description: Backup strategy, documented recovery procedures and regular testing. So your activity survives any incident.

items.title: Support & guidance
items.description: Single technical contact for organizations without an IT department. Regular follow-up, assistance when incidents happen, documentation and team coaching.

creationWeb.title: Your online presence, hassle-free
creationWeb.intro: Modern, fast and accessible websites — built for nonprofits and SMBs that want a professional showcase without agency costs or delays.

items.title: Landing page
items.description: A professional one-page or multi-section website. Responsive design, fast loading, contact form. Turnkey delivery.

items.title: Multi-page site
items.description: Structured site of 3 to 5 pages, no CMS. Ideal for organizations with stable content: about, team, contact.

items.title: Design & branding
items.description: Brand guidelines, mockups and implementation. A site that reflects you, consistent with your communication.

items.title: SEO & performance
items.description: Natural search and performance optimization: Core Web Vitals, tags, sitemap. To be found on Google.

items.title: Redesign
items.description: Modernization of an existing site: new design, technical migration, improved performance and accessibility.

items.title: Maintenance
items.description: Regular updates, automatic backups, availability monitoring and rapid fixes. Your site in good hands.

openSource.title: The site is yours. Actually yours.
openSource.intro: Many cheap offers are rentals: you pay every month, and the day you stop, the site disappears. Here the code is delivered to you under a free licence. You host it where you want, you hand it to whoever you want, and it keeps running even if we stop working together.

points.title: No rental
points.description: You pay once for the build, not a subscription to stay online. Maintenance is a service, not a toll.

points.title: No mandatory provider
points.description: The code is standard and documented. Any developer can take over — me included, but not only me.

points.title: Nothing to take on trust
points.description: The site you are reading is itself published under the AGPL-3.0 licence. You can check how it is built before trusting me with yours.

1 month of hosting and maintenance included

items.name: SMB Visibility

methodology.title: How I work
methodology.intro: A structured four-phase approach, adapted to your organization's operational reality.
methodology.callout: Operational security is not a final state — it's an ongoing process of adapting to threats and to the evolution of your organization.

steps.title: Risk analysis
steps.description: Mapping of your setup: what's critical to your business, what's exposed, what's missing. Findings prioritized to your business.

steps.title: Hardening
steps.description: System hardening, network segmentation, access management, encryption and update policy based on public baselines (CIS).

steps.title: Continuous monitoring
steps.description: Monitoring put in place: dashboards, alerts on anomalies and periodic log review.

steps.title: Incident preparedness
steps.description: Tested backups, written procedures, a simple plan: who to call, what to unplug, how to restart. An incident is prepared before it happens.
